info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update Employee Access API enables organizations to manage employee access rights efficiently within the Human Resource Management system. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify access parameters for individual employees identified by a unique identifier. It is typically utilized by HR administrators and system integrators looking to maintain up-to-date access controls aligned with organizational policies. This operation ensures that employee access is managed seamlessly and stays in sync with changing roles or responsibilities.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the access details for a specific employee identified by their employee ID. Make sure to provide the correct permissions and data format to successfully modify the employee's access settings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the information for a specific employee identified by the employee ID 'EMP-900045'. It contains the necessary fields required to successfully modify the employee's access details within the human resource management system.

201.description: Resource created successfully following the update.
